svg.title: Drill core WD1 from the Walsdorfer maar: lithology, tephra layers and one layer modelled in RDF
svg.text: WDT 216,286 yr b2k ± 4 ka, conservative upper limit
Depth is measured, age is modelled
Anchors: HBT 40Ar/39Ar at 86.43 m, GLT at 20.20 m
Primary tephra are isochrons; reworked layers do not date the sediment
Dashed: strat: classes exist in geo-lod, WD1 instances and IRIs are illustrative
Schenk et al. 2026, Quaternary 9, 67; tables CC BY 4.0, Fiona Schenk (wdt-tables)
